name: ResonantImpact / head

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. Head exploding like a ripe pumpkin: deep wet pop, crunchy rupture, broad pulp splatter and dripping.  Element: A heavy tendon and bone snap followed by two separated metallic resonant pings, then a deep wavering physical pressure ring and scattered settling Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
